description: The move deletes the app only when the plan's target cell is app.yaml's (ADR-0053, ADR-0060 amendment 2026-11-16): the landing zone and the release create it in app.yaml's cell, so a plan naming another one would leave it in a CAE the move didn't check.

patches.find: [ "$to_cell" = "$(prov_app_cell "$slug" "$env_name")" ] || saf_die "the plan moves $slug in $env_name into another capacity cell than app.yaml names"
